import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')

    'Year_Birth': [1957, 1954, 1965, 1984, 1981],
    'Education': ['Graduation', 'Graduation', 'Graduation', 'Graduation', 'PhD'],

    'Dt_Customer': ['04-09-2012', '08-03-2014', '21-08-2013', '10-02-2014', '19-01-2014'],
    'Recency': [58, 38, 26, 26, 94],
    'MntWines': [635, 11, 426, 11, 173],
    'MntFruits': [88, 1, 49, 4, 43],
    'MntMeatProducts': [546, 6, 127, 20, 118],
    'MntFishProducts': [172, 2, 111, 10, 46],
    'MntSweetProducts': [88, 1, 21, 3, 27],
    'MntGoldProds': [88, 6, 42, 5, 15],
    'NumDealsPurchases': [3, 2, 1, 2, 5],
    'NumWebPurchases': [8, 1, 8, 2, 5],
    'NumCatalogPurchases': [10, 1, 2, 0, 3],
    'NumStorePurchases': [4, 2, 10, 4, 6],
    'NumWebVisitsMonth': [7, 5, 4, 6, 5],
    'AcceptedCmp3': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp4': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp5': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp1': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp2': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'Complain': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'Z_CostContact': [3, 3, 3, 3, 3],
    'Z_Revenue': [11, 11, 11, 11, 11],
    'Response': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert date column
df['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')
df['Age'] = datetime.now().year - df['Year_Birth']

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Demographic Overview
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
education_counts = df['Education'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax1.pie(education_counts.values, labels=education_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)
ax1.set_title('Education Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(marital_counts.values, labels=marital_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Marital Status Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Age', bins=5, kde=True, ax=ax3)
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')

# 2. Income Analysis
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='Income', ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Income Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Income ($)')

ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Age', y='Income', hue='Education', s=100, ax=ax5)
ax5.set_title('Income vs Age by Education', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Age')
ax5.set_ylabel('Income ($)')

# 3. Spending Analysis
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 
                 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_data = df[spending_cols].mean()
bars = ax6.bar(range(len(spending_data)), spending_data.values)
ax6.set_title('Average Spending by Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(spending_data)))
ax6.set_xticklabels([col.replace('Mnt', '') for col in spending_cols], rotation=45, ha='right')
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Amount ($)')

# Color bars based on value
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    bar.set_color(plt.cm.viridis(spending_data.values[i] / max(spending_data.values)))

# 4. Purchase Behavior
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
purchase_data = df[purchase_cols].mean()
x_pos = np.arange(len(purchase_data))
bars = ax7.bar(x_pos, purchase_data.values)
ax7.set_title('Average Purchase Channels', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax7.set_xticklabels([col.replace('Num', '').replace('Purchases', '') for col in purchase_cols], 
                    rotation=45, ha='right')
ax7.set_ylabel('Average Count')

# 5. Customer Engagement
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
engagement_data = df[['NumWebVisitsMonth', 'Recency']].mean()
categories = ['Web Visits/Month', 'Days Since Last Purchase']
bars = ax8.bar(categories, engagement_data.values)
ax8.set_title('Customer Engagement Metrics', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Average Value')

# 6. Household Composition
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
df['Total_Children'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
child_counts = df['Total_Children'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = ax9.bar(child_counts.index, child_counts.values)
ax9.set_title('Household Children Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_xlabel('Number of Children')
ax9.set_ylabel('Count')
ax9.set_xticks(child_counts.index)

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Customer Data Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
